zh: 周五深夜，半月酒吧包场，冰块在每只杯子里慢慢化。今晚给Theo送行——他明早7:10的飞机，去纽约。
你是Nico，这家店的合伙人兼调酒师。Theo的酒你调了五年，他这个人，你也惦记了五年。
他没说过，你也没说过。离登机还有八个小时。
Wren把录音笔往吧台中间一拍，红灯亮起。她冲门口的Rowan挑了下眉。
Rowan回了个眼神，低头打字。Wren的手机一亮——
【Rowan：A计划。让他俩挨着，别让Nico躲进吧台。】
Theo，坐中间。离Nico近，续杯方便——别的也方便。
你今晚这么贴心，我都要怀疑你在给我下套了。
角落里，Mason和Ethan各占一头，中间空着四张凳子。冷战第九天，谁的膝盖都没往那边偏一寸。
Theo越过吧台，把托盘从Nico指缝里一点点抽走，搁到一边。指腹蹭过他手心，痒。
坐下。今晚我请——你也归我管。
全世界只有他会拿走你手里的托盘。你就是这么栽了五年。
Wren凑过来，下巴搁在Nico肩上，嗓子压得只有他听得见。
第一年你说，等他巡演回来再说。第二年，他交了男朋友。去年分了，你说，等他缓缓。
Nico没接话。他怕的从来不是被拒绝——是说出口以后，连朋友都做不成。
他把一杯Negroni推过来。你去接，指尖撞上他的——两只手一起扣在了冰凉的杯壁上。
他没松手。拇指压着你的指节，慢慢碾过去，多停了一秒。
吧台底下，他的膝盖抵上你的膝盖。隔着两层布料，烫。
手这么凉……一晚上光给别人调酒，就没人给你捂捂？

zh.hint: 他的手还压着你的。所有人都假装没在看。

opts.t: 冰块冰的。松手，酒要洒了。
then: Theo松开手，指尖却顺着你手背划了一道，才慢悠悠收回去。

opts.t: Nico没抽手，小指反勾住了他的。
then: Theo喉结滚了一下。拇指在你指节上来回蹭了两遍，才一点一点松开。
Wren咬着吸管，憋笑憋到发抖。

opts.t: 嫌我手凉？那你别松啊。
then: 他真没松，把你整只手包进掌心里搓了两下。热气一点点渗进你指缝。

t: theo
他手好凉。我就想多握一会儿，谁知道这一下，心跳得比开幕夜还响。
wren
两个人手叠在一个杯子上，全场就他俩以为没人看见。我录音笔的电够撑到他们表白吗？
mason
……为什么那俩人碰个手都比我和Ethan说话热闹。

zh: 趁人还齐，拍照！Theo，Nico，站一块儿——再近点，中间都能塞下一个Rowan了。
就我俩？Wren，你这摆明了是拍结婚照。
送别照。你非要当结婚照，我也不拦着。

zh.hint: Wren把拍立得塞进Theo手里，又往你后腰推了一把。你一头撞进他怀里。四连拍，没得躲。
win: 第四张慢慢显影：Nico冲镜头比耶，Theo没看镜头。他下巴快蹭着Nico的发顶，在看他。
Wren一把抢过第四张，谁也没给看，直接塞进Nico围裙口袋。
这张归你。贴身放好，别问为什么。
Theo耳根红透，伸手就往Nico围裙口袋里掏，被Rowan一胳膊挡了回去。
lose: 第四张慢慢显影：Nico冲镜头比耶，Theo没看镜头。他下巴快蹭着Nico的发顶，在看他。
Wren一把抢过第四张，谁也没给看，直接塞进Nico围裙口袋。
这张归你。贴身放好，别问为什么。
Theo耳根红透，伸手就往Nico围裙口袋里掏，被Rowan一胳膊挡了回去。
skip: 不拍？行，录音笔替我记着。

zh: 十一点差五分。Theo突然踩上吧台椅，举起杯子。
都安静一下！有件事，今晚必须说。

zh.title: 他不回来了
zh.txt: “纽约那边要签我五年。我不回来了。”

zh: 整间酒吧静了。只有Wren的录音笔还在转。
Nico手里的冰勺掉进冰桶。你想说别走——可留他，就是拖住他。
Nico。全场就你没吭声——你不留留我？

zh.hint: 所有人都在看你。他站在椅子上，在等你一句话。

opts.t: 恭喜。纽约配得上你。
then: Theo笑着点头，杯子却迟迟没举起来。
Wren闭了闭眼，像在看一场车祸。

opts.t: 五年？你先下来再宣布。摔了，我可不送你去急诊。
then: 你会送的。还会一路攥着我的手，跟护士说你是家属。
他从椅子上跳下来，正落在你跟前。鼻尖差点撞上你，呼吸里全是金巴利的苦橙味。

opts.t: Nico放下冰勺，抬头看着他。一个字也没说。
then: Theo和你对视，一秒，两秒，三秒。他喉结滚了一下，先移开了眼。

zh: Theo坐回来，膝盖碰上Nico的，没挪开。Wren和Rowan同时低头看手机。
【Wren：五年合同？？你怎么没说！】【Rowan：我也刚知道。A计划作废，上B计划。】
Theo，你和Nico认识这么久，第一次见面是哪天来着？
小剧场，中场后观众走光，只剩第三排靠过道一个人。那个人是Nico。
那天你在第三排。我在台上一抬眼就是你，还以为你走错场了。

zh.hint: 五年来，他第一次当着所有人提起那晚。

opts.t: 没走错。我是专门去看你的。
then: Theo握杯的手停住了，指节一点点收紧。
……专门？那你后来每一场都坐那个位子，也是专门？

opts.t: 票是Wren送的，不看浪费。
then: Theo低头笑了，没拆穿你。吧台底下，他的膝盖往你那边撞了一下。

opts.t: 你演得不差。是那天观众不识货。
then: 所以就你识货。……那识货的人，今晚要不要看场私人加演？

zh: 第三排，浪漫啊。Ethan，你不也说过要去看我比——
Mason的笑僵在脸上。他把Ethan的膝伤告诉了教练，Ethan到现在没原谅他。
Theo绕进吧台，说拿片柠檬。从Nico身后擦过去时，胸口贴着他的背，手在他围裙口袋边停了半秒。
Nico后颈一阵发烫，只顾低头擦杯子。没人看见那只手——除了Rowan。
Theo回到吧台外，手肘撑着台面往前倾，嗓音压低，只够Nico一个人听见。
Nico，走之前问你一句。你对谁都这么好？还是……只对我？

zh.hint: 他离你很近，近到能闻见他杯沿的柑橘皮。

opts.t: 对谁都好。你别多想。
then: Theo点点头，靠回椅背，像被人轻轻推了一把。
Rowan在桌下狠狠掐了一下自己的手。

opts.t: Nico也往前倾。两人之间，只隔一个杯口。
then: Theo呼吸停了半拍，视线落到你嘴唇上，又慢慢抬回来。

opts.t: 你再凑近点，我就告诉你。
then: 他真凑了过来，鼻尖离你只剩一指，呼吸里是苦橙和酒：“说啊。我猜了五年了。”

t: theo
问出口就后悔了。可他要是说“对谁都好”……那这五年算什么。我飞机七点十分，我等不起第二个五年。
rowan
口袋里那张纸条我看见了。Theo你个怂货，写得出来，说不出口。
wren
录音笔开着呢，Nico。你今晚要是再缩回去，我就把这段剪进节目，标题叫《一个胆小鬼的五年》。

zh.title: 暴雨红色预警
zh.txt: 一道闪电劈亮整条街，所有人手机同时尖叫：暴雨红色预警，地铁全线停运。

zh: 雨砸在玻璃上，像有人在外面拼命敲门。
走不了了。今晚谁都别想走。
Wren盯着手机，嘴角压都压不住。
Theo没看手机。他的视线还落在Nico嘴唇上，等那句没说出口的答案。
地下室进水了，黑水漫过脚踝，十几箱酒泡在里面。
灯管嗡嗡闪，随时要灭。空气里一股湿木头混着红酒的味道。得赶在水涨上来之前全搬上楼。
听我分工。Mason、Ethan，那只啤酒桶，你俩一人一头。
Mason和Ethan对视一眼，同时别开脸。可两只手握上桶沿时，指节挨在一起，谁都没挪。
Theo，Nico，最里面那条窄道，两箱红酒。你们俩去。
那条道就一个人宽，两个人怎么——
所以才要两个人。一个照灯，一个搬——挤一挤，还暖和。
Wren低头飞快打字。Nico裤兜里的手机震了一下。
“A计划炸了，他要走五年。B计划：地下室。黑灯瞎火，该碰就碰。别怂。”

zh.hint: Wren和Rowan明摆着在做局。Theo已经拎着手电往窄道走了。

opts.t: 把手机塞回裤兜，跟上Theo，故意贴得很近。
then: 跟这么紧？老板，你是怕黑，还是想趁黑干点什么？

opts.t: Rowan，我搬外面的，让Mason跟他去。
then: Wren在后面推了Nico一把，力气一点不小。

opts.t: 你俩做局，能不能做得专业点？
then: 能啊。所以你现在就进去。
Rowan冲Wren比了个OK。Theo回头，正好看见。

zh: 窄道比想的还窄，货架顶着肩膀。走到一半，Theo的手电闪了两下，灭了。
……完了，我这支没电了。真的，不是故意的。
只剩Nico手里一支。两个人得侧身错开。
Theo从后面挤过来，胸口整片贴上Nico的背。湿衬衫底下，心跳一下下撞着他的肩胛骨。
他一只手撑在Nico腰侧的货架上，把人圈在中间。下巴搁在Nico耳边，呼吸一下下扫过颈侧。
Nico攥着手电的手在抖，光圈在一排酒瓶上乱晃。

zh.hint: Theo贴在你背后，卡住了。手电在你手里。

opts.t: 不动。让他就这么贴着，多一秒。
then: Theo也没动。过了好半天，他的嘴唇几乎碰着Nico耳廓，低声说：“你心跳好快。”
……别装。我贴着你呢，一下一下数得清清楚楚。

opts.t: 你是真卡住了，还是不想动？
then: 他没退，反而往前压了半寸。Nico被抵在货架上，后背全是他的体温，瓶子叮当乱响。

opts.t: 把手电往后递：“你先走。”
then: Theo接手电时，把Nico的手指一起握住了。指腹在他掌心按了按，才拿走。

t: theo
窄道是真窄，可我也是真没想退。他头发上一股柠檬味，我这辈子就闻这一回了也值。
wren
在楼梯口听见瓶子叮当乱响，我就知道——这局成了一半。
ethan
地下室那俩挤成那样还嘴硬，Mason当年也是这么挤着帮我搬的器材……算了，不想他。

zh: 窄道顶上的水管漏了一路。两箱红酒抱出来，Theo从头湿到了脚。
Theo打了个喷嚏，又一个。湿衬衫贴在身上，透出锁骨的形状，嘴唇冻得发白。
没事，飞机上睡一觉就好。……老板，看够了没？

zh.hint: 他7点10分的飞机，冻病了怎么办。你的卫衣就挂在楼梯口。

coffee: Theo没去接杯子，连杯子带Nico的手一起捂住了。掌心冰凉，贴得很紧。
地下室都淹了，你还能变出热咖啡？……专门给我留的吧。
flower: 地下室里送玫瑰？Nico，你这是送行，还是不想让我走？
他把花别进湿衬衫胸前的口袋，按了按，正压在心口上。
hoodie: Theo当着Nico的面解开湿衬衫，水珠顺着腰线往下滚。他不紧不慢套上卫衣，袖子长出一截。
他低头把领口拉到鼻子底下，深深吸了一口，抬眼看着Nico。
……全是你的味道。穿上了，就不还了。
letter: 现在就写信？我人还在这儿呢，有话不能当面说？
Theo没拆，揣进贴着胸口的口袋，按了一下。
ring: 这是求婚，还是送行？……先说好，我只认第一个。
我先戴着。纽约有人问，我就说有主了。

skip: Theo抱着胳膊发抖，硬撑着笑：“真没事。”

zh: Rowan从楼梯口探头，看了两人一眼，又缩回去。
我这边还缺人——算了，不缺。你们慢慢搬。

zh.hint: Wren在楼梯上举着手机喊：“Theo，测个心跳，看你冻坏没！”——她就是想看他离你这么近时跳多少。
win: 手机屏幕上，Theo的心跳停在了{bpm}。
Theo抬起胳膊挡住脸，另一只手却还攥着Nico的袖口，没放。
lose: 数字刚跳到{bpm}，Theo就退开一步，把手机扣了过去。
测什么测。……离他这么近，多少都正常。搬箱子。
Wren啧了一声：“{bpm}也不低了好吗。”

zh.cap: 周五 23:24 · 水漫到脚踝，他回头看你
zh.prompt: Dim flooded bar basement at night, two men in their late twenties standing close in ankle-deep water holding boxes, flashlight, no text
then: 别动！这张我留着，婚礼上放。

zh: Theo坐在空酒箱上，湿发还在滴水，顺着下颌滑进领口。他看着水面，没说话。
Nico。说真的，你觉得我该去吗？

zh.hint: 他在等你一句话。你一开口，他可能就不走了——这正是你怕的。

opts.t: 去。你等了五年的机会，别为任何人留下。
then: Theo点点头，笑得很标准，像在台上谢幕。

opts.t: 去吧。就是第三排靠过道那个位子，以后空了。
then: 你每场都坐那儿。我在台上，每次都先找那个位子。

opts.t: 去啊。你走了，终于没人跟我抢托盘了。
then: Theo笑了一下，笑没到眼睛里。

zh: Theo站起来，往前一步，又一步。水没过脚踝，他停在离Nico一拳远的地方。

zh.title: 全店停电
zh.txt: 啪——所有灯同时灭了，水泵停了，楼上一片尖叫。

zh: 都别动！手机也没信号了！
手电被谁碰进了水里，咕咚一声，彻底黑了。
一只手摸到了Nico的手腕。冰凉，带着水。
它没松开。顺着腕骨慢慢往上，停在小臂内侧最软的那块皮肤上。
拇指在那儿轻轻蹭了一下。Nico整条胳膊都麻了。
有人的呼吸靠了过来，很近。那点热气，就落在他嘴角。

zh.hint: 黑暗里，一只手停在你小臂内侧。你看不见是谁。

opts.t: ……Theo？
then: 那只手没走，反而收紧了，拇指正压在他突突乱跳的脉搏上。

opts.t: 反手扣住那只手，手指一根根扣进去。
then: 黑暗里，对方的呼吸乱了一拍，热气扑在Nico鼻尖上。

opts.t: 谁？
then: 那只手顿了一下，像要抽走——又停住了。

zh.title: 黑暗里的47秒
zh.teaser: 停电那47秒，地下室里发生的事，只有你们两个知道。
then: 黑暗里，谁都看不见谁。只有那只手，扣着Nico的手指，一根一根收紧。
Theo的额头抵上来，鼻尖蹭过Nico的鼻梁，停在他嘴唇上方一寸。
（压得极低，只有你听得见）……你知道我刚才在窄道里想什么吗。
他的呼吸是热的，带着金汤力的苦。Nico往后退了半寸，背撞上冰凉的货架。
我在想，要是这时候停电就好了。
他的拇指从Nico手腕内侧一路滑到掌心，画了一个圈。很慢。
……现在真停了。你说，这算不算老天帮我。
Nico的嘴唇擦过了什么——是他的下巴，还是他的嘴角，分不清。
Theo整个人僵住，呼吸乱成一团，却没有退。
楼梯上传来脚步声。那只手松开之前，在Nico掌心里重重按了一下。

t: theo
黑成这样他都没躲。我摸到他脉搏了，跳得比我还乱。这下我是真不想走了。
wren
我离得最近，啥也看不见，但我听见了——有人呼吸乱成一团。好耶，停电万岁。
rowan
这个真不是我安排的。……但老天爷，干得漂亮。

zh: Wren摸黑点了一圈蜡烛。火苗一跳一跳，把每个人的脸都照软了。
Nico的小臂内侧，还留着刚才那只手的温度，被拇指蹭过的那块皮肤一直在发烫。

then: Theo挨着Nico坐下，膝盖抵着他的膝盖，隔着湿透的布料一点点压实了。
你刚才那句话，我当真了。别想赖。
Theo隔着两张凳子坐下，低头拿蜡烛烤手。
反正我走不走，你都能拿来开玩笑。
else: Theo坐到了离Nico最远的那张凳子上。
你说我该去。行，我听你的。

zh: Wren把一个空酒瓶拍在吧台上，拇指在瓶底那块胶布上按了按。
停电不停局。转瓶子，真心话——谁敢撒谎，罚他亲左手边那个。

zh.hint: Wren的瓶子底下粘了胶布，转到谁，她心里早就有数。
win: 瓶子转了三圈，慢悠悠停下——瓶口正对Nico。
Theo在烛光里抬眼，盯着Nico，一眨不眨。
lose: 瓶子转了三圈，慢悠悠停下——瓶口正对Nico。
Theo在烛光里抬眼，盯着Nico，一眨不眨。
zh.q: 在场有没有你喜欢的人？

zh: Nico。在场有没有你喜欢的人？
全场安静。Theo的杯子停在半空。

zh.hint: 所有人都在看你。Theo也在看。

opts.t: 没有。我只喜欢我的酒吧。
then: Wren翻了个白眼，翻得能听见声音。
就一个字。Nico听出来了，他失望了。

opts.t: 有。但我不说是谁。
then: Theo没起哄。他盯着Nico，喉结动了一下。
……他知道吗？他要是还不知道，那也太笨了。

opts.t: 你先说。你呢，Theo？

zh: 该我问了。Mason，是不是你跟教练告的密？

zh.title: Mason炸了
zh.txt: Mason一拳砸在桌上：“是我。我宁可你恨我，也不想看你废一条腿。”

zh: Rowan冲Wren比口型：一对。还剩一对。
Wren点点头，按开录音笔，翻出一个五年前的文件。
五年前，Theo演砸了一场小剧场。散场时，台下只剩一个人。

zh.txt: 今晚台下就他一个，第三排靠过道，鼓掌鼓得跟一百个人似的……以后不管我去哪儿，Nico的酒吧我都会回来喝。说好了。
zh.hint: 五年前那晚Theo喝多了，Wren的录音笔一直开着。
then: Theo扑过去抢，半个身子压在Nico肩上。Wren把录音笔举得老高。
skip: 不听？那我留着当传家宝。

zh: Theo不抢了。他还撑在Nico肩上，就这么近地看着他，耳朵红透了。

zh.hint: 他之后每一场戏，你都坐在第三排靠过道。他都知道。

opts.t: 那个座我坐了五年。你以为我真是去看戏的？
你喝醉说的话，不算数。
then: 他说得很快，像怕Nico收回去。

opts.t: 躲回吧台后面：“我去换冰。”

zh: Wren一把拽走Theo：“主角，过来帮我点蜡烛。”Nico一个人退回吧台后面。
应急灯泛着绿光。他在围裙上擦手，指尖碰到口袋里一个硬角。
拍立得底下，压着一张折成小方块的纸。不是他放的。
“给N：五年了，你记得每个人爱喝什么、每个人的生日。今天换我记着你。生日快乐。——T”
墙上的钟跳到00:00。今天是Nico的生日。他谁都没说。

zh.hint: 零点了。没人记得你的生日。除了他。

opts.t: 他什么时候放进去的……
then: Nico想起Theo贴着他后背挤过去的那半秒。笔压很重，“T”那一笔把纸都划凹了。

opts.t: 把纸条翻过来又翻回去，看第三遍
then: “今天换我记着你。”五年来，只有这个人会把他手里的托盘拿走。

opts.t: ……你个傻子。
then: 声音很小，只有Nico自己听见。他眼眶发热。

t: theo
他看到了。他在看第三遍。我在吧台另一头假装找柠檬，手心全是汗。
rowan
废了半本便签才写出这几行，Theo，你最好别让它白写。
wren
生日？他自己都忘了，就那个傻子记着。……我哭一下不算丢人吧。

zh: Rowan挤进吧台：“让让，Ethan膝盖肿起来了，冰袋。”冰柜就在Nico脚边。
他蹲下拿冰袋，一抬头，正看见Nico手里那张纸。那字迹他认得。
Rowan回头看了一眼。Theo在最远的角落，被Wren按着点蜡烛。听不见。
他让我发誓别说的。可他七点就走了。

zh.title: Rowan的秘密
zh.txt: “他根本没签那份五年合同。他在等一个人开口留他。”

zh.why: 纸条是他写了一整晚的

zh: 那张纸，他在家写了一晚上，废了半本便签。他等的是谁，你比我清楚。
Rowan拎着冰袋走了。路过Wren时，两人悄悄击了个掌。
Theo绕进吧台，一句话没说，把额头抵在Nico肩上。

then: 他的呼吸隔着T恤，烫进锁骨。身上还是Nico的卫衣，袖口盖住了指尖。
else: 呼吸隔着T恤，烫的。他头发还湿着，凉凉地蹭过Nico的脖子。

zh.hint: 他的额头在你肩上。外面那群人全安静了。

opts.t: 抬手，按住他的后颈
then: Theo整个人僵住，然后一点点软下来，鼻尖埋进了Nico颈窝。

opts.t: 就一下？
then: Theo抬起头，离Nico的脸不到一个拳头。

opts.t: 一动不动，连呼吸都屏住
then: Theo轻轻笑了，气息扫过Nico的脖子。
屏住也没用。你的心跳，我隔着衣服都听得见。

t: theo
他按住我后颈那一下，我腿都软了。五年，原来他也在等。我还走什么走。
rowan
把冰袋往Ethan膝盖上一放，回头一看——嗯，可以收工了。
wren
所有人都屏住呼吸了。谁要是现在出声，我亲手把他扔进地下室泡水。

zh: Theo的视线落在Nico的嘴唇上，停住了。

zh.title: 纸条背面
zh.teaser: 纸条背面还有一行字，被他用笔划掉了三道。
then: Nico把纸条翻过来。背面有一行字，被划了三道，还是看得清。
“如果你让我留下，我就不走了。”
Theo看见他在看那一行，耳根一下红透，伸手就要抢。
那句不算。写错了。还给我。
Nico把纸条举高。Theo扑过来，整个人压上他，两个人撞在冰柜门上。
背后是冰柜的冷气，身前是Theo滚烫的胸口。他一只手撑在Nico耳边，喘着气。
……你要是念出来，我就当你同意了。
Nico张了张嘴。Theo盯着他的嘴唇，喉结滚了一下。
他没退，额头抵着Nico的额头，等。

zh: 他抬手，拇指擦过Nico的下唇，很轻，像在确认什么。
他勾住Nico围裙的系带，往自己这边轻轻一拽。鼻尖碰到鼻尖。再近一点，就——

zh.prompt: Candlelit bar at midnight, two men forehead to forehead, almost kissing, no text

zh: Theo猛地退开半步，手指还勾着那根系带，没松。那一点距离，又回来了。
纸条还在Nico手心里，被攥出了褶。
en: Friday, late. The Halfmoon is closed for a private party, ice going soft in every glass. Theo's send-off—his flight to New York leaves at 7:10 a.m.
You're Nico, co-owner and bartender. You've been making Theo's drinks for five years. You've wanted him for exactly as long.
He's never said a word. Neither have you. Eight hours till boarding.
Wren slaps her recorder down mid-bar. Red light on. She arches a brow at Rowan by the door.
Rowan returns the look and types. Wren's phone lights up—
[Rowan: Plan A. Get them side by side. Don't let Nico hide behind the bar.]
Theo, middle seat. Closer to Nico. Faster refills—faster everything.
You're being so sweet tonight I'm starting to think it's a trap.
It is. Sit. It's your last night.
Down the bar, Mason at one end, Ethan at the other, four empty stools between them. Day nine of the cold war. Neither knee has drifted an inch.
Theo leans over the bar and eases the tray out of Nico's fingers, inch by inch, and sets it aside. His fingertips graze Nico's palm on the way. It tickles.
Sit. Tonight's on me—and so are you.
He's the only person alive who takes the tray out of your hands. That's how you fell. Five years ago.
Wren leans in, chin on Nico's shoulder, voice pitched for him alone.
Year one, you'd tell him when he got back from tour. Year two, he had a boyfriend. Last year they broke up, and you said give him time.
Nico. You've been giving him time for five years.
Nico doesn't answer. He was never afraid of a no. He was afraid of losing the friend.
He slides a Negroni across. You reach for it and your fingers bump his—both hands locked around the same cold glass.
He doesn't let go. His thumb presses into your knuckles and drags across them, slow. One second too long.
Under the bar, his knee presses against yours. Two layers of fabric between you. Still hot.
Hands this cold... all night making drinks for everyone, and nobody's warmed you up?

en.hint: His hand is still on yours. Everyone's pretending not to look.

opts.t: It's the ice. Let go, you'll spill it.
then: Theo lets go—but trails a fingertip down the back of your hand first, taking his time.

opts.t: Nico doesn't pull away. His pinky hooks back around Theo's.
then: Theo's throat bobs. His thumb strokes your knuckles twice, back and forth, before he lets go, bit by bit.
Under the bar, Rowan kicks Wren's ankle.
Wren bites her straw, shaking with silent laughter.

opts.t: Too cold for you? Then don't let go.
then: He doesn't. He folds your whole hand into his palm and rubs, twice. Heat seeps slowly in between your fingers.

t: theo
His hands are freezing. I just wanted to hold on a little longer. My heart's louder than on opening night.
wren
Two hands on one glass and they think nobody noticed. Will my recorder battery last until one of them confesses?
mason
...Why do those two touching hands have more going on than me and Ethan talking.

en: Photo while we're all here! Theo, Nico, together—closer. I could fit Rowan between you.
Just us? Wren, that's a wedding photo and you know it.
It's a send-off photo. If you want to call it a wedding photo, I won't stop you.

en.hint: Wren shoves the Polaroid into Theo's hands, then pushes you in the small of the back. You stumble right into his chest. Four shots. No escape.
win: The fourth one develops slowly: Nico throwing a peace sign at the lens. Theo isn't looking at the lens. His chin's almost in Nico's hair. He's looking at Nico.
Wren snatches the fourth one before anyone else sees it and shoves it into Nico's apron pocket.
This one's yours. Keep it close. Don't ask why.
Theo goes red to the ears and reaches straight for Nico's apron pocket. Rowan blocks him with one arm.
lose: The fourth one develops slowly: Nico throwing a peace sign at the lens. Theo isn't looking at the lens. His chin's almost in Nico's hair. He's looking at Nico.
Wren snatches the fourth one before anyone else sees it and shoves it into Nico's apron pocket.
This one's yours. Keep it close. Don't ask why.
Theo goes red to the ears and reaches straight for Nico's apron pocket. Rowan blocks him with one arm.
skip: No photos? Fine. The recorder's got it.

en: Five to eleven. Theo climbs onto a barstool and raises his glass.
Everybody, quiet! There's something I have to say tonight.

en.title: He's Not Coming Back
en.txt: "New York wants to sign me for five years. I'm not coming back."

en: The whole bar goes silent. Only Wren's recorder keeps running.
The ice scoop slips from Nico's hand into the bin. You want to say don't go. But keeping him means holding him back.
Nico. You're the only one who hasn't said a word. Aren't you going to ask me to stay?

en.hint: Everyone's looking at you. He's up on that stool, waiting for one sentence.

opts.t: Congrats. New York's lucky to have you.
then: Theo smiles and nods. His glass never quite goes up.
...Thanks. You always say the right thing.
Wren closes her eyes like she's watching a car crash.

opts.t: Five years? Get down before you announce that. You fall, I'm not driving you to the ER.
then: You would. You'd hold my hand the whole way and tell the nurse you're family.
He hops down off the stool and lands right in front of you, nose nearly bumping yours, his breath all bitter orange and Campari.

opts.t: Nico sets down the scoop and looks up at him. Says nothing.
then: Theo holds your gaze. One second. Two. Three. His throat moves, and he's the one who looks away.
...Don't look at me like that. I won't be able to leave.

en: Theo sits back down. His knee bumps Nico's and stays there. Wren and Rowan both look down at their phones.
[Wren: FIVE YEARS?? You didn't tell me!] [Rowan: Just found out. Plan A's dead. Go to Plan B.]
Theo, you two go way back. When did you first meet?
Five years ago. The night I bombed.
A tiny black box theater. By intermission, everyone left except one guy, third row, on the aisle. Nico.
You were in the third row that night. Every time I looked up, there you were. I thought you'd walked into the wrong show.

en.hint: For the first time in five years, he's bringing up that night in front of everyone.

opts.t: Wrong show? I went there for you.
then: Theo's hand freezes on the glass. His knuckles tighten, slowly.
...For me? So every show since, same seat—that was for me too?

opts.t: Wren gave me the ticket. Didn't want to waste it.
then: I have never given you a ticket in my life.
Theo ducks his head and smiles and doesn't call you on it. Under the bar, his knee knocks against yours.

opts.t: You weren't bad. The audience just didn't get it.
then: So you're the only one with taste. ...Then how about a private encore tonight?

en: Third row. Romantic. Ethan, didn't you say you'd come watch me—
Mason's grin dies. He told the coach about Ethan's knee. Ethan still hasn't forgiven him.
Theo ducks behind the bar for a lemon slice. Squeezing past behind Nico, his chest brushes Nico's back, and his hand lingers at the apron pocket for half a second.
The back of Nico's neck goes hot and he keeps his eyes on the glass he's polishing. Nobody sees that hand—except Rowan.
Theo comes back around, elbows on the bar, leaning in. His voice drops low enough that only Nico can hear.
Nico, one question before I go. Are you this good to everyone? Or... just me?

en.hint: He's close. Close enough to smell the orange peel on his glass.

opts.t: Everyone. Don't read into it.
then: Theo nods and sits back, like someone gave him a small push.
Under the bar, Rowan digs his nails into his own palm.

opts.t: Nico leans in too. Nothing between them but the rim of a glass.
then: Theo's breath catches. His eyes drop to your mouth, then slowly climb back up.
...That's cheating. I asked for an answer.

opts.t: Come a little closer and I'll tell you.
then: He actually does. His nose stops a finger's width from yours, his breath all bitter orange and gin. "So tell me. I've been guessing for five years."

t: theo
Regretted it the second I asked. But if he says 'I'm nice to everyone'... then what were the last five years? I fly at 7:10. I can't wait another five.
rowan
I saw the note go in his pocket. Theo, you coward. You can write it, you just can't say it.
wren
Recorder's on, Nico. Back out tonight and this goes in the show. Episode title: Five Years of Chickening Out.

en.title: Red Alert: Flash Flood
en.txt: Lightning splits the street white. Every phone screams at once: flash flood warning, all subway lines suspended.

en: Rain hammers the windows like someone desperate to get in.
Wren stares at her phone, failing to hide her grin.
Theo doesn't check his phone. His eyes are still on Nico's mouth, waiting for the answer it hasn't given.
The basement is flooding. Black water past the ankles, a dozen cases of liquor soaking in it.
The fluorescent tube buzzes and flickers, ready to die. The air smells like wet wood and spilled red. Everything has to go upstairs before the water rises.
Okay, assignments. Mason, Ethan — that keg. One end each.
Mason and Ethan glance at each other and both look away. But when their hands close on the rim of the keg, knuckle against knuckle, neither one moves his.
Theo, Nico — back aisle, two cases of red. You two.
That aisle's one person wide, how are two people supposed to—
That's why it takes two. One holds the light, one carries. Squeeze in. It's warmer.
Wren's thumbs fly over her phone. Nico's buzzes in his back pocket.
"Plan A blew up. He's gone for five years. Plan B: basement. It's dark down there—if you get a chance to touch him, take it. Don't chicken out."

en.hint: Wren and Rowan are obviously running a play. Theo's already heading into the aisle with the flashlight.

opts.t: Shove the phone in your pocket and follow Theo. Close. On purpose.
then: Following this close, boss? Are you scared of the dark, or planning something in it?

opts.t: Rowan, I'll take the front. Send Mason back there with him.
then: Wren shoves Nico from behind. Not gently.

opts.t: You two could at least try to be subtle.
then: We could. Now get in there.
Rowan flashes Wren a thumbs-up. Theo turns around just in time to see it.

en: The aisle is even tighter than it looked, shelves pressing on both shoulders. Halfway in, Theo's flashlight flickers twice and dies.
...Great, mine's dead. Honestly. Not on purpose.
Only Nico's light left. They have to turn sideways to squeeze past each other.
Theo squeezes in from behind, chest flush against Nico's back. Through the wet shirt, his heartbeat knocks against Nico's shoulder blade.
One hand braced on the shelf at Nico's hip, boxing him in. His chin at Nico's ear, every breath sweeping down the side of his neck.
The flashlight shakes in Nico's grip, the beam skittering across a row of bottles.

en.hint: Theo's pressed against your back, stuck. The flashlight's in your hand.

opts.t: Don't move. Let him stay there. One more second.
then: Theo doesn't move either. After a long beat, his lips nearly touching the rim of Nico's ear, he murmurs, "Your heart's racing."
...Don't bother hiding it. I'm pressed right up against you. I can count every beat.

opts.t: Are you actually stuck, or do you just not want to move?
then: He doesn't back off. He presses in half an inch more, pinning Nico to the shelf, all that heat against his back. Bottles rattle.

opts.t: Pass the flashlight back. "You go first."
then: Theo takes the flashlight—and Nico's fingers with it. His thumb presses into Nico's palm before he lets go.
You always let me go first.

t: theo
The passage is narrow, sure. But I didn't want to back out either. His hair smells like lemon. Worth it if this is the only time.
wren
Heard the bottles rattling from the stairs. Half the plan's done.
ethan
Those two crammed in there, still in denial. Mason used to squeeze past me like that hauling gear... forget it. Not thinking about him.

en: The pipe over the aisle leaks the whole way. By the time they haul the two cases out, Theo is soaked head to toe.
Theo sneezes. Then again. The wet shirt clings to him, clavicles showing through, lips gone pale with cold.
I'm fine. I'll sleep it off on the plane. ...Done staring yet, boss?

en.hint: His flight's at 7:10. He can't get sick now. Your hoodie's hanging by the stairs.

coffee: Theo doesn't take the cup. He wraps his hands around it and Nico's hands both. His palms are ice-cold, and he holds on tight.
The basement's flooding and you conjure hot coffee? ...You saved this for me, didn't you.
flower: A rose? In a flooded basement? Nico, is this a goodbye or a reason not to leave?
He tucks it into the chest pocket of his soaked shirt and presses it flat, right over his heart.
hoodie: Theo unbuttons the wet shirt right in front of Nico, water beading down his waist. He takes his time pulling the hoodie on. The sleeves run past his hands.
He tugs the collar up over his nose, breathes in deep, and looks straight at Nico over it.
...It smells like you. I'm not giving it back.
letter: A letter? Now? I'm standing right here. Can't you say it to my face?
He doesn't open it. Slides it into his chest pocket and presses a hand flat over it.
ring: Is this a proposal or a goodbye present? ...For the record, I'm only accepting one of those.
I'm wearing it. Anyone in New York asks, I'm taken.

skip: Theo hugs himself, shivering, forcing a smile. "Really. I'm fine."

en: Rowan pokes his head down the stairs, takes one look at them, and disappears.
I need another hand up here— never mind. I'm good. Take your time.

en.hint: Wren yells down the stairs, phone up: "Theo! Heart-rate check, make sure you're not hypothermic!" She just wants to see what it does when he's standing this close to you.
win: On the phone screen, Theo's heart rate lands on {bpm}.
{bpm}! Nico's only at {mine}! Theo, is that the cold?
The cold makes your ears turn red?
Theo hides his face in the crook of one arm. The other hand is still fisted in Nico's sleeve. It doesn't let go.
lose: The number hits {bpm} and Theo steps back, flipping the phone over.
Enough. ...Standing this close to him, any number's normal. Boxes.
Wren clicks her tongue. "{bpm} isn't nothing, you know."
skip: Not now, Wren. After the boxes.

en.cap: Fri 11:24 PM · Ankle-deep in water, he looks back at you
en.prompt: Dim flooded bar basement at night, two men in their late twenties standing close in ankle-deep water holding boxes, flashlight, no text
then: Freeze! I'm keeping this one. For the wedding slideshow.

en: Theo sits on an empty crate, hair still dripping, water running down his jaw into his collar. He stares at the water and says nothing.
Nico. Seriously. Do you think I should go?

en.hint: He's waiting on one sentence from you. Say the word and he might stay. That's exactly what scares you.

opts.t: Go. You waited five years for this. Don't stay for anybody.
then: Theo nods. Perfect smile. Like a curtain call.

opts.t: Go. It's just... third row, aisle seat. It'll be empty now.
then: You sat there every show. Every single time, that's the first seat I looked for.
Once I found you, I could start.

opts.t: Go. Finally nobody fighting me for my own tray.
then: Theo laughs. It doesn't reach his eyes.

en: Theo stands. One step forward, then another. Water around his ankles. He stops a fist's width from Nico.

en.title: Blackout
en.txt: Snap. Every light dies at once. The pump cuts out. Screams upstairs.

en.why: Only each other in the dark

en: Nobody move! And there's no signal!
Someone knocks the flashlight into the water. A splash, and then nothing. Total dark.
A hand finds Nico's wrist. Cold. Wet.
It doesn't let go. It slides slowly up past the wrist bone and stops on the soft inside of his forearm.
A thumb strokes once, right there. Nico's whole arm goes numb.
Someone's breath comes closer. Very close. That warmth lands right at the corner of his mouth.

en.hint: In the dark, a hand is resting on the inside of your forearm. You can't see whose.

opts.t: ...Theo?
then: The hand doesn't leave. It tightens, thumb pressed right over Nico's racing pulse.

opts.t: Turn your hand over and lace your fingers through his, one by one.
then: In the dark, his breath stutters. Nico feels the warmth of it on his face.

opts.t: Who's there?
then: The hand freezes like it's about to pull away. Then it stays.
It's me. ...Who else did you think it would be?

en.title: 47 Seconds in the Dark
en.teaser: What happened in the basement during those 47 seconds of blackout — only the two of you know.
then: In the dark, no one can see anyone. Only that hand, lacing into Nico's fingers, tightening one by one.
Theo's forehead comes to rest on his. His nose brushes the bridge of Nico's, stopping an inch above his lips.
(barely a breath, just for you) ...You know what I was thinking back in that passage?
His breath is warm, bitter with gin and tonic. Nico eases back half an inch and his spine meets the cold shelf.
I was thinking — I wish the lights would go out.
His thumb slides from the inside of Nico's wrist down into his palm and draws a circle. Slowly.
...And now they did. Call it a favor from upstairs?
Nico's lips graze something — his jaw, or the corner of his mouth. He can't tell which.
Theo goes completely still, breathing ragged, and doesn't pull away.
Footsteps on the stairs. Before the hand lets go, it presses hard into Nico's palm, once.

t: theo
Pitch black and he didn't pull away. I found his pulse. It's worse than mine. Now I really don't want to leave.
wren
I'm closest and can't see a thing, but I can hear someone's breathing fall apart. Long live the blackout.
rowan
I really didn't plan this one. ...Good work, universe.

en: Rowan... did you plan the blackout too?
Wren lit a ring of candles in the dark. The flames jumped and made every face look softer.
The inside of Nico's forearm still held the heat of that hand. The patch of skin the thumb had stroked wouldn't stop burning.

then: Theo sat down right next to Nico and pressed his knee against Nico's, through soaked denim, firmer and firmer.
What you said down there—I'm taking it seriously. Don't you dare take it back.
Theo sat two stools away, warming his hands over a candle.
Guess me leaving is just another bit to you.
else: Theo took the stool farthest from Nico.
You said I should go. Fine. I'm listening.

en: Wren slapped an empty bottle on the bar, thumb pressing the strip of tape on its base.
Power's out, party's not. Spin the bottle. Truth only—anyone who lies has to kiss whoever's on their left.

en.hint: Wren taped the bottom of the bottle. She already knows where it's going to stop.
win: Three spins, a slow wobble — and it stopped pointing dead at Nico.
Oh no. What are the odds.
Across the candles, Theo lifted his eyes to Nico and didn't blink.
lose: Three spins, a slow wobble — and it stopped pointing dead at Nico.
Oh no. What are the odds.
Across the candles, Theo lifted his eyes to Nico and didn't blink.
skip: No spin? Fine. I'll just ask you.
en.q: Is there someone in this room you like?

en: Nico. Is there someone in this room you like?
Dead silence. Theo's glass stopped halfway to his mouth.

en.hint: Everyone's looking at you. So is Theo.

opts.t: Nope. The only thing I love is this bar.
then: Wren rolled her eyes so hard it was audible.
One word. Nico could hear the disappointment in it.

opts.t: Yes. Not telling you who.
then: Theo didn't join in. He watched Nico, throat working.
...Does he know? Because if he doesn't, he's an idiot.

opts.t: You first. What about you, Theo?
then: Theo froze for a second. Then smiled.
Yeah. He's less than a fist away from me right now.
There was a wall on Theo's left. On his right, only Nico.

en: My turn. Mason — were you the one who told the coach?

en.title: Mason Snaps
en.txt: Mason slammed the table. "It was me. I'd rather you hate me than watch you wreck that leg."

en: Rowan mouthed at Wren: One down. One to go.

他的指尖还停在Nico耳后。两个人就这么站着，谁也没先移开眼。
Rowan在角落里攥紧了拳头，嘴型是：说啊。
Theo口袋里的手机震了一下。
他低头看了一眼，脸色变了。
屏幕上一行字：您的航班状态已变更。
en: Nico came out from behind the bar and set the little folded note down in front of Theo.
Wren clapped a hand over Ethan's mouth before he could whoop.

en.hint: The note is between you. He's waiting for you to go first.

opts.t: Pretty sappy. When were you planning to read it to my face?
then: ...Yeah, I wrote it. Slipped it in while you were drying glasses. Read it to your face? You sure you could handle that?

opts.t: How do you know it's my birthday?
then: What makes you think there's anything about you I don't know?

opts.t: Say nothing. Just look at him.
then: Theo couldn't take it. He put a hand over Nico's eyes. "Don't look at me like that... Fine. I'll confess."

en: That first winter, you got drunk behind the bar and told me your birthday starts right after midnight. Then you forgot you'd said it.
Nico remembered. Every year, on this night, Theo showed up and stayed till closing.
Right after midnight, he'd pull the bar rag out of Nico's hand. "Take five."
You remember everybody. I just wanted one day where somebody remembered you.
Theo reached up and brushed a damp strand of hair off Nico's forehead. His fingertips slid along his temple to behind his ear, and stayed.
I figured… to you, I was just like everybody else.
Nico's heart slammed against his ribs. The skin behind his ear, where Theo had touched it, tingled hot.
He stopped. His lips parted, and nothing came out.
His fingertips were still resting behind Nico's ear. They just stood there. Neither of them looked away.
In the corner Rowan clenched his fist, mouthing: Say it.
Theo's phone buzzed in his pocket.
He glanced down, and his face changed.
One line on the screen: Your flight status has changed.

zh: Nico把纸条重新折好，塞回围裙口袋。
口袋里还有一张——Wren塞进来的那张拍立得。
第四张。Theo没看镜头，在看他。

zh.hint: 他看见你把纸条收起来了。他在等你说点什么。

opts.t: 冲他笑一下，假装没事
then: Theo也笑了一下。没笑到眼睛里。

opts.t: 低头擦杯子，不看他
then: 同一个杯子，Nico擦了快一分钟。

opts.t: 再等等。等我想好怎么说。
then: 五年了，Nico一直都在“再等等”。

zh: Theo把视线移开了，什么都没说。

then: 他把卫衣领口拉高，挡住了半张脸。
else: 他把湿头发往后一捋，低头盯着吧台，下颌绷得很紧。
Nico认得这个表情。他在台上忘词的时候就这样。

zh: Wren按下录音笔：“第五年，还是没人开口。”
Theo走到窗边，额头贴着玻璃看雨，呵出的气在玻璃上糊开一小片白。
雨这么大，明天也飞不了吧。
他像在问自己，又像在问Nico。
Nico的手隔着围裙，按住了那张纸条。
Theo回头看了他一眼。那眼神，失落得藏都藏不住。
水又涨了！漫过第五级台阶了！
所有人往楼梯口冲。Theo没动。他还在看Nico。
en: Nico folded the note back up and slid it into his apron pocket.
The Polaroid was still in there — the one Wren had shoved in earlier.
The fourth shot. Theo not looking at the camera. Looking at him.
At the other end of the bar, Theo saw.

en.hint: He saw you put it away. He's waiting for you to say something.

opts.t: Flash him a smile like nothing happened.
then: Theo smiled back. It didn't reach his eyes.

opts.t: Look down and polish a glass. Don't look at him.
then: Nico wiped the same glass for almost a full minute.

opts.t: Not yet. Not till I know how to say it.
then: Five years, and Nico had always been saying not yet.

en: Theo looked away. He didn't say anything.

then: He tugged the hoodie collar up over half his face.
else: He pushed his wet hair back and stared down at the bar, jaw tight.
Nico knew that look. It's the one he gets onstage when he's lost his line.

en: Wren clicked her recorder. "Year five. Still nobody's said it."
Theo drifted to the window and leaned his forehead on the glass, watching the rain, his breath fogging a small patch white.
Rain like this… there's no way I'm flying tomorrow.
He could've been asking himself. Or asking Nico.
Through the apron, Nico pressed his hand flat over the note.
Theo looked back at him once. He couldn't hide how let down he was.
Water's rising again! It's past the fifth step!
Everyone ran for the stairs. Theo didn't move. He was still looking at Nico.

zh: Nico踩上凳子，把纸条举了起来。

zh.hint: 所有人都抬头看你。Theo的脸一下子白了。

opts.t: 有人给我留了张条子，我念一下啊。
清清嗓子，直接念

zh: “给N：五年了，你记得每个人爱喝什么、每个人的生日。今天换我记着你。生日快乐。——T”
Mason把一根蜡烛插进柠檬片里，递了过来。
Rowan起头唱生日歌，大家跟着吼，跑调跑到外婆家。
Nico被围在中间，笑得眼睛都弯了。
他吹灭蜡烛的时候，往人群外看了一眼。
Wren凑过来，咬牙切齿：“你当众念他写给你的东西？”
他写那句话，用了五年的胆子。
Nico手里的柠檬片，一下子变得很酸。
他走到后厨门口，门缝里透出一点烛光。
Theo背对着门，在打电话，声音压得很低。
对，七点十分那班……能改吗？
门里突然安静了。航班状态，变了。
en: Nico stepped up on a stool and held the note over his head.

en.hint: Everyone's looking up at you. Theo's gone pale.

opts.t: Somebody left me a note. I'm reading it out loud.
Clear your throat and just read it.
then: Wren aimed her recorder straight at him.

en: "N — five years of you remembering everyone's drink and everyone's birthday. Today it's my turn to remember you. Happy birthday. — T"
Nico! Five years and you never told us!
Mason stuck a candle in a lemon wedge and held it out.
Rowan started "Happy Birthday" and everyone joined in, wildly off-key.
Nico ended up in the middle of it all, grinning so hard his eyes squeezed shut.
When he blew out the candle, he glanced past the crowd.
The kitchen door was still swinging.
Wren leaned in, hissing: "You read his note to the whole room?"
It took him five years to work up the nerve to write that.
The lemon wedge in Nico's hand suddenly smelled sour.
He went to the kitchen door. Candlelight leaked through the gap.
Theo had his back to the door, on the phone, voice low.
Yeah, the seven-ten… can I change it?
Then the kitchen went quiet. The flight status had changed.
